scripts.build:extension: wxt build && rm -rf dist/extension && mkdir -p dist/extension && cp -R .output/chrome-mv3/. dist/extension/ && cd dist/extension && zip -qr speak-page-actions.zip .
scripts.build:site: npm run build:extension && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && mkdir -p dist/site/downloads && cp dist/extension/speak-page-actions.zip dist/site/downloads/speak-page-actions.zip
